title: The Fallen Outpost
description: Two actors must clear a fallen outpost and recover a distress beacon. A hostile sentry blocks the inner gate; defeating it opens the eastern passage. A hostile patrol guards the courtyard; a ward-talisman (in the supply camp) can calm it. A scout in the courtyard offers intelligence when talked to. A medkit in the supply camp revives a defeated teammate. NPC respawn applies: sentry after 4 ticks, patrol after 3 ticks. Actor defeat drops held items; a teammate with a medkit can revive the fallen. All state persists across save/load/reconnect.
